SELECT
    OT.SOURCE_CODE,
    OT.SCHEMA_NAME,
    OTR.DATA_LAYER,
    OTR.TASK_NAME,
    OTD.DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME,
    CAST(OTR.PROCESS_DATE AS DATE) PROCESS_DATE,
    OS.STATUS,
    OTR.START_DATETIME,
    OTR.END_DATETIME
FROM
    OM.OM_TASK_RUN OTR
LEFT JOIN
    OM.OM_STATUS OS ON OTR.STATUS_ID = OS.STATUS_ID
LEFT JOIN
    OM.OM_TASK_DEPENDENCY OTD ON OTR.TASK_NAME = OTD.TASK_NAME
LEFT JOIN
    OM.OM_TASKS OT ON OTR.TASK_NAME = OT.TASK_NAME
ORDER BY
    5 DESC;
